human_understanding_delta: The first open mixed cell extends through the entire one-sided cubic range c>=-10^-4 because the cubic vanishes on both rays and has a fixed favorable chord shape. It cannot extend through arbitrary c by choosing the antipodal chord: at c=-2 the original chord is positive at its midpoint and the antipodal chord is positive at an endpoint where the cubic vanishes. Mixed first-mode geometry therefore requires a genuine cubic-coordinate stratification, unlike the pure second-mode plane.
